data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 周末居室的慵懒毛绒时光
data.description: 周末阳光正好的客厅软沙发上，弥子穿着宽大的薰衣草紫连帽衫蜷坐着，鼻梁上架着金丝圆眼镜，两手捧着热牛奶，显得格外娇柔温软。
data.action: curled up on sofa, oversized hoodie, round glasses, holding warm mug, shy smile
data.lighting: bright cheerful morning sunlight bathing soft cushions
data.promptProse: Curled up comfortably on a sunlit living room couch wearing an oversized cozy lavender hoodie and round glasses, Iino Miko cradles a warm mug and looks up with a tender, bashful smile.
data.animaCaption: Miko curled up in an oversized hoodie on the sofa with a warm mug.
